title: Axe-cut Cun
text: Axe-cut Cun uses angular side-brush strokes, sharp edges, dark accents, and firm structural planes. It is appropriate for hard rocky cliffs and steep mountains.

title: Hemp-fiber Cun
text: Hemp-fiber Cun uses long layered fiber-like strokes. It is suitable for rounded earthen mountains, soft slopes, and densely vegetated terrain.

title: Mi-dot Texture
text: Mi-dot texture uses moist horizontal ink dots and diffuse washes to describe misty hills, rain, humid atmosphere, and indistinct vegetation.

title: Water Rendering
text: Water should be rendered with sparse pale lines, restrained washes, or untouched paper. Avoid dense repetitive texture unless depicting waves.

title: Pine Brushwork
text: Pine trunks use dry controlled strokes and textured bark. Needles are grouped rhythmically with dark concentrated ink.

title: Atmospheric Wash
text: Fog and clouds should use diluted ink, soft edges, discontinuous contours, and broad unpainted transitions.
